propositions: Pandoc subprocess invocations lack caller-side timeout and process group reaping, allowing a pathological input to hang indefinitely (observed 13.5 min spin) because subprocess.run(timeout=) reaps only the direct child, not grandchildren holding pipes.
The pandoc binary from pypandoc-binary wheel has GPL license provenance that must be recorded and verified to remain stable and in compliance.

The renderer currently uses subprocess.run() which does not allow graceful process group termination on timeout; it must use subprocess.Popen(start_new_session=True) with communicate(timeout=) and rebar._proc.reap_process_group on TimeoutExpired.

Safe-run batching to reduce pandoc spawn overhead was prototyped but descoped because it changes rendered output on ~12% of bodies while saving only ~12% of spawns (46% of runs are single-unit, making the 74% ceiling unreachable).
The dc_pandoc_timeout_s config key (default 10s) must be reachable from config file, environment, and documented across schema, sources, golden config, and docs.
Rendered output must remain byte-identical to the landed renderer across the 178-body corpus, proving this change hardens robustness only and does not alter rendering behavior.
